pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with highly serrated, toothed edges. The gradients between dark and light pelage exhibit micro-fringe textural transitions. Patch area is maximal on the upper shoulder and decreases significantly toward the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-colored pathways forming a non-uniform topological lattice. Junction nodes predominantly feature 3-way and 4-way intersections. Pathway pixel thickness is greatest at the base of the neck and narrows to fine, high-frequency lines on the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude serrated profile along the dorsal neck. The mane consists of short, dark, upward-oriented hair structures creating a fine-grained jagged edge against the background.
